name: BigQuery to Pub/Sub
description: Reads every row of a BigQuery table (or query) and publishes one Pub/Sub message per row: requestPayload becomes the message body, headers become the message attributes.

parameters.name: outputTopic
parameters.label: Output Pub/Sub topic
parameters.helpText: Topic to publish to, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/my-topic. Required unless it is set in the env properties file.

parameters.name: inputTable
parameters.label: Input BigQuery table
parameters.helpText: Table to read, e.g. my-project:my_dataset.my_table. Provide either inputTable or query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.label: Input BigQuery query
parameters.helpText: Standard SQL query to read instead of a whole table. Provide either inputTable or query.

parameters.name: headersColumn
parameters.label: Headers column
parameters.helpText: Column published as message attributes. Defaults to headers.

parameters.name: payloadColumn
parameters.label: Payload column
parameters.helpText: Column published as the message body. Defaults to requestPayload.

parameters.name: env
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.helpText: Load defaults from application-<env>.properties bundled in the jar (dev, qa or prod). Other parameters override it.
